content: निदानम् .²1 A band, rope, halter; उदुस्रियाणामसृजन्निदानम् <ls>Rv. 6. 32. 2</ls>. .²2 A rope for tying up a calf; बालजेन निदानेन कांस्यं भवतु दोहनम् <ls>Mb. 13. 94. 41</ls>. .²3 A primary cause, the first or essential cause; निदानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्य सन्ततेः <ls>R. 3. 1</ls>; अथवा बलमारम्भो निदानं क्षयसम्पदः <ls>Śi. 2. 94</ls>. .²4 A cause in general; मुञ्च मयि मानमनिदानम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²5 (in medicine) Inquiry into the causes of a disease, pathology. .²6 Diagnosis of a disease. .²7 End, termination. .²8 Purity, purification, correctness. .²9 Claiming the reward of penitential acts.
